profile.headline: Senior Associate Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: Graduated from the University of Maryland at College Park with a B.S. in biology. Strong interests in biochemistry and software development. Through my work, I aim to contribute to the advancement of technology and science to create a more sustainable, efficient, and equitable lifestyle for all.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
1 year of experience as an SRE developer on a team that specialized in transitioning internal teams to use serverless architecture, specifically Fargate. Work included inner sourcing to other internal projects, maintaining cloud accounts and infrastructure per enterprise standards, and maintaining a fullstack application.
- experience inner sourcing to other projects and CLI tools in Golang, Python, etc.
- experience in AWS, especially in server less compute engines such as Fargate and lambda 
- fullstack and API development
- experience in python, typescript, svelte, terraform
- experience in enterprise CICD tools and infrastructure

1 year of experience working on a micro frontend framework that powers applications used by internal agents to support Capital One customers.
- Fargate based frontend framework
- typescript, React, Vue, Vite, Webpack
- experience building libraries and working on a full stack application
- experience with client side rendering and server side rendering

positions.title: Plasma Dynamics Researcher
positions.description:
Researched and gained a basic understanding of plasma dynamics with the goal to advance the knowledge and potential of utilizing the sun's energy for a more sustainable method of energy harvesting. Plotted data collected from the Voyager mission on Jupyter Notebook, including the tendencies of termination shock and pickup ions in relation to proton temperature and AU (created scripts in Python). The research focused on the physical characteristics of plasma, the motion of charged particles in magnetic fields, and related concepts in electromagnetics.

The current role expands on the past years of research and includes incorporating research in proposals, technical papers, and more.

positions.title: Innovation Intern
positions.description:
Experience working as a innovation intern. Daily tasks would include assisting lead scientists in performing tests that would drive decisions regarding to on demand drug formulation.
- experience carrying out experiments safely 
- experience documenting experiments and creating reports
- weigh out dry and wet organic chemicals, and dispose of chemical waste appropriately 
- experience with spectroscopy, distillation, chromatography, crystallization/recrystallization tests, etc.

positions.title: Mars Reconnaissance Intern
positions.description: Working with the Mars Reconnaissance team, I conducted research to communicate the viability of methods and technology to reach reconnaissance and science initiatives, ultimately to get humans to the surface of Mars.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description: Created script to make metadata from OCR from digitized articles.

company.name: Smithsonian Institution, Museum of Natural History

positions.title: Veterinary Technician
positions.description: Assisted veterinarians in vaccinating, medicating, and caring for patients. As a technician, I also conducted lab work and recorded medical records. As a receptionist, I filled medications, faxed information, scheduled appointments, and handled the cash register.

honors.title: Bowie State University Alumni Association Scholarship

projects.title: Proposal for the Implementation of BlockChain Cash Technology into the Bank of America Mobile Banking Application
projects.description: My team and I proposed the idea of utilizing blockchain technology into mobile banking apps to reduce rates of fraud and to promote quicker, cheaper transactions for the benefit of both the bank and the customer.
